56650-paganism-surviving-in-christianity.title: Paganism Surviving In Christianity
56650-paganism-surviving-in-christianity.creator: Unknown
56650-paganism-surviving-in-christianity.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is the story of the struggle between right and wrong; the record of God’s dealing with men. The “historic argument” is invaluable, because history preserves God’s verdicts concerning human choices and actions. Events and epochs, transitions and culminations, are the organized causes and effects which create the never-ceasing movement, and the organic unity called history.

66018-miss-lochinvar-a-story-for-girls.title: _A Story For Girls_
66018-miss-lochinvar-a-story-for-girls.creator: Marion Ames Taggart
66018-miss-lochinvar-a-story-for-girls.description: A book by Marion Ames Taggart. The big dining-room looked a trifle dreary in spite of the splendor of its appointments; in spite, too, of the fact that there were enough children’s faces around the long table to have brightened it.

arxiv-2106-08587.title: Engineering many-body quantum Hamiltonians with non-ergodic properties using quantum Monte Carlo
arxiv-2106-08587.creator: N. Swain, H.-K. Tang, D. C. W. Foo, B. J. J. Khor, G. Lemarié, F. F. Assaad, P. Sengupta, S. Adam
arxiv-2106-08587.description: Abstract We present a computational framework to identify Hamiltonians of interacting quantum many-body systems that host non-ergodic excited states. We combine quantum Monte Carlo simulations with the recently proposed eigenstate-to-Hamiltonian construction, which maps the ground state of a specified parent Hamiltonian to a single non-ergodic excited state of a new derived Hamiltonian.

arxiv-2112-12763.title: Microchannel cooling for the LHCb VELO Upgrade I Journal: Nuclear Instruments and Methods A
arxiv-2112-12763.creator: Oscar Augusto De Aguiar Francisco, Wiktor Byczynski, Kazu Akiba, Claudia Bertella, Alexander Bitadze, Matthew Brock, Bartosz Bulat, Guillaume Button, Jan Buytaert, Stefano De Capua, Riccardo Callegari, Christine Castellana, Andrea Catinaccio, Catherine Charrier, Collette Charvet, Victor Coco, Paula
arxiv-2112-12763.description: Abstract The LHCb VELO Upgrade I, currently being installed for the 2022 start of LHC Run 3, uses silicon microchannel coolers with internally circulating bi-phase CO 2 \mathrm{CO_{2}} for thermal control of hybrid pixel modules operating in vacuum. This is the largest scale application of this technology to date.

arxiv-2203-12476.title: Stable Optimization for Large Vision Model Based Deep Image Prior in Cone-Beam CT Reconstruction
arxiv-2203-12476.creator: Minghui Wu, Yangdi Xu, Yingying Xu, Guangwei Wu, Qingqing Chen, Hongxiang Lin \sthanks Corresponding author: Hongxiang Lin (Email: harryhxlin@gmail.com). This work was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant No. 12301546 and Zhejiang Provincial Natural Scien
arxiv-2203-12476.description: Abstract Large Vision Model (LVM) has recently demonstrated great potential for medical imaging tasks, potentially enabling image enhancement for sparse-view Cone-Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT), despite requiring a substantial amount of data for training. Meanwhile, Deep Image Prior (DIP) effectively guides an untrained neural network to generate high-quality CBCT images without any training data.

arxiv-2209-15336.title: Hadron productions and jet substructures associated with Z 0 / γ Z^{0}/\gamma in Pb+Pb collisions at the LHC
arxiv-2209-15336.creator: Shan-Liang Zhang, Hongxi Xing, Ben-Wei Zhang
arxiv-2209-15336.description: Abstract We carry out a detailed study of medium modifications on Z 0 Z^{0} / γ \gamma +hadron correlations as well as jet substructures in association with Z 0 / γ Z^{0}/\gamma in Pb+Pb collisions with s N ​ N = 5.02 \sqrt{s_{NN}}=5.02 TeV at the LHC.

arxiv-2302-13541.title: Solar Energetic Particle Events with Short and Long Onset Times
arxiv-2302-13541.creator: Kosuke Kihara, Ayumi Asai, Seiji Yashiro, Nariaki V. Nitta
arxiv-2302-13541.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kosuke Kihara, Ayumi Asai, Seiji Yashiro, Nariaki V. Nitta. Gradual solar energetic particle (SEP) events, usually attributed to shock waves driven by coronal mass ejections (CMEs), show a wide variety of temporal behaviors. For example, TO, the > > 10 MeV proton onset time with respect to the launch of the CME, has a distribution of at least an order of magnitude, even when the source region is not far from the so-called well-connected longitudes.

arxiv-2312-14910.title: Versal deformations: a tool of linear algebra Thanks: Received by the editors on Month/Day/Year. Accepted for publication on Month/Day/Year. Handling Editor: Namie of Handling Editor. Corresponding Author: Andrii Dmytryshyn
arxiv-2312-14910.creator: Andrii Dmytryshyn
arxiv-2312-14910.description: Abstract Versal deformation of a matrix A A is a normal form to which all matrices A + E A+E , close to A A , can be reduced by similarity transformation smoothly depending on the entries of A + E A+E .

arxiv-2403-17910.title: Beyond chromatic threshold via the ( p , q ) (p,q) -theorem, and a sharp blow-up phenomenon
arxiv-2403-17910.creator: Hong Liu, Chong Shangguan, Jozef Skokan, Zixiang Xu
arxiv-2403-17910.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hong Liu, Chong Shangguan, Jozef Skokan, Zixiang Xu. We establish a novel connection between the well-known chromatic threshold problem in extremal combinatorics and the celebrated ( p , q ) (p,q) -theorem in discrete geometry. In particular, for a graph G G with bounded clique number and a natural density condition, we prove a ( p , q ) (p,q) -theorem for an abstract convexity space associated with G G .

arxiv-2405-03236.title: Federated Reinforcement Learning with Constraint Heterogeneity
arxiv-2405-03236.creator: Hao Jin, Liangyu Zhang, Zhihua Zhang
arxiv-2405-03236.description: Abstract We study a Federated Reinforcement Learning (FedRL) problem with constraint heterogeneity. In our setting, we aim to solve a reinforcement learning problem with multiple constraints while N N training agents are located in N N different environments with limited access to the constraint signals and they are expected to collaboratively learn a policy satisfying all constraint signals.

arxiv-2410-12364.title: An informal introduction to the Parisi formula
arxiv-2410-12364.creator: Jean-Christophe Mourrat
arxiv-2410-12364.description: Abstract . This note is an informal presentation of spin glasses and of the Parisi formula. We also discuss some models for which the Parisi formula is not well-understood, and some partial progress that relies upon a connection with partial differential equations.

arxiv-2510-10644.title: Hierarchical Optimization via LLM-Guided Objective Evolution for Mobility-on-Demand Systems
arxiv-2510-10644.creator: Yi Zhang, Yushen Long, Yun Ni, Liping Huang, Xiaohong Wang, Jun Liu
arxiv-2510-10644.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yi Zhang, Yushen Long, Yun Ni, Liping Huang, Xiaohong Wang, Jun Liu. Online ride-hailing platforms aim to deliver efficient mobility-on-demand services, often facing challenges in balancing dynamic and spatially heterogeneous supply and demand. Existing methods typically fall into two categories: reinforcement learning (RL) approaches, which suffer from data inefficiency, oversimplified modeling of real-world dynamics, and difficulty enforcing operational constraints; or decomposed online optimization methods, which rely on manually designed high-level objectives that lack awareness of low-level routing dynamics.

arxiv-2510-25994.title: Hyperbolic Fracton Model, Subsystem Symmetry and Holography III: Extension to Generic Tessellations
arxiv-2510-25994.creator: Yosef Shokeeb, Ludovic D.C. Jaubert, Han Yan (闫寒)
arxiv-2510-25994.description: Abstract We generalize the Hyperbolic Fracton Model from the { 5 , 4 } \{5,4\} tessellation to generic tessellations, and investigate its core properties: subsystem symmetries, fracton mobility, and holographic correspondence. While the model on the original tessellation has features reminiscent of the flat-space lattice cases, the generalized tessellations exhibit a far richer and more intricate structure.

pmc-10640685.title: Building Phylogenetic Trees From Genome Sequences With kSNP4
pmc-10640685.creator: Barry G Hall, Jeremiah Nisbet, Koichiro Tamura
pmc-10640685.description: Performing phylogenetic analysis with genome sequences maximizes the information used to estimate phylogenies and the resolution of closely related taxa. The use of single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) permits estimating trees without genome alignments and permits the use of data sets of hundreds of microbial genomes.

pmc-11465405.title: Association of Race or Ethnicity With Extended-Spectrum Beta-Lactamase Production in Escherichia Coli: A Case Control Study
pmc-11465405.creator: Alice N Hemenway, Mark Biagi, Timothy F Murrey, Jiehuan Sun, Erica Osei-Badu, Adriana Salazar-McKinney, Ricardo Sanabria, Moamen Al Zoubi
pmc-11465405.description: BackgroundThere are limited and conflicting data regarding the impact of race or ethnicity on the rate of gram-negative antimicrobial resistance. This study was performed to determine whether there is a difference in extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL) Escherichia coli infection or colonization in minoritized patients when compared to White patients from a diverse US Midwestern city.

pmc-11471202.description: Information regarding the radiation risk posed by radioactive emissions from the petrologic units in North eastern Nigeria is extremely limited. Consequently, there has been little research conducted on the environmental impact of radiation exposure from different petrologic units in this region.

pmc-11498979.title: Clinical Analysis of 32 Cases of Subglottic Benign Airway Stenosis Treated With Montgomery T Silicone Stent
pmc-11498979.creator: Zhenyu Yang, Xiaoli Zhou, Wenying Pan, Daxiong Zeng, Junhong Jiang
pmc-11498979.description: Objective: To explore the complications of long-term placement of Montgomery T silicone stent (T-tube) in the treatment of subglottic benign airway stenosis (SBAS) and the timing of successful T-tube removal. Methods: We retrospectively collected the clinical data of 32 patients with SBAS who underwent the treatment of T-tube and analyzed their placement and successful removal of the T-tube.

pmc-11654362.title: Availability and affordability of diabetes healthcare services associated with the frequency of diabetes-related complications
pmc-11654362.creator: Mehran Alijanzadeh, Sima Hashemipour, Fereshteh Attaran, Samira Saremi, Leila Modarresnia, Hamidreza Ghafelehbashi, Mark D. Griffiths, Zainab Alimoardi
pmc-11654362.description: AimsUnderstanding the healthcare access challenges facing diabetic patients in low- and middle-income countries is very important. The present study investigated the association between availability (physical access) and affordability (economic access) to diabetes healthcare services and the frequency of diabetes-related complications.MethodsA cross-sectional survey study was conducted between February and May 2023 in Qazvin, Iran.

pmc-11690784.title: DUAL PRIORITIES: DIGITAL TWINS AND HEALTH CARE DESIGN THAT SUPPORTS OLDER ADULTS IN THE CONTEXT OF STAFFING SHORTAGES
pmc-11690784.creator: Felix Kabo, Jake Morrison, Chad Ritsema
pmc-11690784.description: Aging populations are associated with a growing need and demand for specialized care, including healthcare environments that accommodate unique needs such as mobility assistance, chronic disease management, post-acute care, and mental health support. Currently, there are more than 46 million Americans aged 65 or over, and this number is projected to double by 2060.

pmc-13420840.title: Mechanically aligned total knee arthroplasty demonstrates acceptable outcomes in obese patients, with insufficient evidence for alternative alignment strategies: A systematic review
pmc-13420840.creator: Helena Son, Andjela Dragovic, Marc Daniel Bouchard, Maaya Chander, Prushoth Vivekanantha, Hassaan Abdel Khalik, Naser Ali Alenezi, Luca Farinelli, Darren de SA, Amit Meena
pmc-13420840.description: PurposeObesity (body mass index [BMI] ≥ 30 kg/m2) is increasingly prevalent among total knee arthroplasty (TKA) patients and is associated with unique challenges. The role of various TKA alignment strategies in obese patients remains unclear. To evaluate the clinical, functional, radiographic, survivorship and complication outcomes of primary TKA in obese patients across alignment philosophies.

pmc-13651352.title: Impact of context on nurse-led implementation of evidence-based pain management practices in the Sumamos Excelencia project: a qualitative study
pmc-13651352.creator: Leticia Bernués-Caudillo, Azucena Pedraz-Marcos, Esther González-María, Mª Teresa Moreno-Casbas
pmc-13651352.description: BackgroundContext analysis is a key element in the implementation of evidence-based practice. It contributes to understanding why certain interventions succeed in some settings and fail in others, while also supporting the tailoring of implementation strategies to different populations and settings. This task becomes especially challenging when implementing complex interventions that involve multidisciplinary teams operating across multiple organisations.

pmc-13666985.title: Combined Association of High-Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein and Vitamin D with Short-Term Functional Outcomes in Acute Ischemic Stroke
pmc-13666985.creator: Seongmin Choi, Yunjung Rho, Min-Su Kim, Myung Chul Yoo, Ga Yang Shim, Jin San Lee, Sung Joon Chung, Yunsoo Soh
pmc-13666985.description: Background/Objectives: Whether high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) and vitamin D (Vit D) provide complementary prognostic information for acute ischemic stroke is unclear. We examined the separate and joint associations of serum hsCRP and Vit D levels with short-term functional outcomes after acute ischemic stroke.

uslaw-usc-t48-s1452.title: 48 U.S.C. § 1452 — Regulation of Indians
uslaw-usc-t48-s1452.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t48-s1452.description: United States Code, Title 48 (Territories And Insular Possessions); Chapter 10 (Territorial Provisions Of A General Nature). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Nor shall anything in title 23 of the Revised Statutes be construed to affect the authority of the United States to make any regulations respecting the Indians of any Territory, their lands, property, or rights, by treaty, law, or otherwise.
